'''Electromagnetic pulse generators''' were a component of [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaves]]<ref name="FaDCR">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> and [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Energy lance/Legends|energy lances]]. They released an [[Electromagnetic pulse/Legends|electromagnetic pulse]] that was especially effective against [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref>
